text:
rachel: Dropping a compact mock for the trace header. Quick poll: where to surface the correlation permalink and how should the export action behave for very long traces? https://www.figma.com/file/zzz/trace-header-prop

omar: I like the idea of a tiny secondary row under the title for permalinks/corr id. Keeps the title centered and avoids horizontal crunch.

liam: Dev note: make permalink clickable (open request explorer). Have a separate copy icon that copies the full permalink. Avoid click-to-copy on the whole label.

frida: Accessibility: copy icon must have an aria-label with the full id, focusable, and 44px touch target on mobile. Tooltips should be accessible on focus (aria-describedby).

rachel: Microcopy: primary CTA should read `Download trace` (defaults to JSON). Secondary dropdown for CSV / flattened-CSV / HAR. For huge traces we should fall back to async prep and surface progress.

omar: UX for async: show a centered modal with progress and an option to receive an email link. Also post a non-blocking toast with `View export progress` so users can continue working.

liam: Backend will return job id + status endpoint. When export starts, move keyboard focus to the progress region (role=status) so screen readers announce updates. Close modal on completion and show a success toast with a direct download link.

frida: Contrast/accessibility nit: the copy icon color on the dark header fails contrast at current tokens. Use an icon color token that meets at least 3:1 for secondary and 4.5:1 if promoted. Also ensure focus ring is always visible.

rachel: Visual shorthand: show `Corr` + truncated hash (e.g., d4f2...a9b). Full id revealed in tooltip/aria. Clicking truncated hash navigates to request explorer, clicking copy icon copies permalink.

omar: On mobile, prefer a single stacked row: [Title] [Corr d4f2...a9b] [Download trace]. Make icons larger and show text label for copy if screen width < 360px.

liam: Events to instrument: export_initiated, export_async_started, export_ready, export_failed, export_clicked. Include trace_length and spans_count in payload for metrics.

design-bot: Quick scan: flagged 1 issue - tooltip contrast in header variant. Report: /reports/1991234567

frida: I'll update the accessibility checklist in the PR template to include focus handling for async modals and aria-live/role=status usage.

rachel: Thanks folks. I'll push an updated Figma with the breadcrumb-under-title pattern + async export modal and tag for final review in ~40m.
